hooks.command: IN=$(cat); f=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.cpp|*.cc|*.cxx|*.hpp|*.hh|*.hxx|*.h|*.inl|*.ipp) s=$(printf %s "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); if [ -n "$s" ]; then m="/tmp/cppmd-claude-$s"; [ -e "$m" ] && exit 0; touch "$m"; fi; [ -f "$HOME/.claude/CPP.md" ] && jq -n --rawfile g "$HOME/.claude/CPP.md" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:("You are working on C++ code. Follow this guide (~/.claude/CPP.md):\n\n"+$g)}}' || :;; esac
